name: crypto random fill range
source: import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer'; import { randomFillSync } from 'node:crypto'; function main(): void { const value = Buffer.alloc(8); randomFillSync(value, 2, 3); const hex: string = value.toString('hex'); console.log(hex.startsWith('0000'), hex.endsWith('000000'), hex.length); }
